summary: Completed comprehensive testing of birth plan edit features. Backend functionality is fully working, but identified critical frontend integration issue preventing edit button from appearing.

integration_issues.issue: Edit button not visible when accessing completed birth plans directly via URL

integration_issues.impact: Users cannot edit submitted birth plans even with remaining uses

design_issues.issue: HTML validation warning: div nested inside p element in dialog

Token usage increment on birth plan completion
Reset clears visited_categories and current_category_index correctly
Reset sets birth plan status back to in_progress
Reset rejection when no remaining uses available
Token validation returns proper token_info structure
Birth plan complete page loads correctly
Frontend navigation through birth plan categories
success_percentage: backend: 100% (15/15), frontend: 70% (7/10 - core issue prevents full edit flow)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend integration issue: In BirthPlanPage.js loadBirthPlan function (line 63-86), add API call to fetch token information when loading existing plans. The tokenData should be populated from the birth plan's token_id so that canEdit logic works correctly for direct plan access.
